## buddy-sbx describe

Show details of a specific resource

### Synopsis

Describe displays detailed metadata, configuration, and runtime status of a resource.

Supported resource types:
  - sandboxes (aliases: sandbox, sbx)
  - sessions  (aliases: session, sess)
  - users     (aliases: user)

```
buddy-sbx describe <resource> <name> [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  # Describe a sandbox
  buddy-sbx describe sandbox my-box

  # Describe a sandbox using shorthand
  buddy-sbx describe sbx my-box

  # Describe a supervisor session
  buddy-sbx describe session sess-9b9ad3488cc2 -s my-box

  # Describe a session in path format
  buddy-sbx describe sess my-box/sess-9b9ad3488cc2

  # Describe a user account
  buddy-sbx describe user usr_alice
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help             help for describe
  -o, --output string    Output format (json)
  -s, --sandbox string   Target sandbox for child resources (sessions)
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --config string     Path to config file (default: ~/.buddy/config.yaml)
      --endpoint string   Buddy Gateway endpoint URL (overrides context)
      --token string      Authentication token (overrides context)
```
